Both tests fail, so minimality gives $G=H_0$.

If $B+ad$ is nonplanar, retain its $K_{3,3}$ subdivision and
apply Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision}. This keeps both
tests nonplanar, so minimality again leaves $B$ unchanged.
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction}, with added
edge $ad$, gives $563$ bridges for each exterior.
Every resulting graph has a $K_5$ minor or a proper
nontoroidal minor except four in the $cd$ case, isomorphic
to $\mathfrak T_{52},\mathfrak T_{57},\mathfrak T_{58},\mathfrak T_{59}$.
In the first three, two twin triples meet twice or not at all.
In the last, some choice of twin pairs leaves a component
with four neighbors~\supp{E33}.
